answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the lagoon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The beacon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the delta is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
